parsed.reason: The message violates the core requirement for weekend_fallback: it must say "the weekend options I just sent" or equivalent ("ce que je viens de t'envoyer"), but optionsSent is false, meaning no options were actually sent yet. Additionally, weekend_fallback must reference the options that were just sent to establish context; inventing that options were sent is a critical error.
